construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, question, grid_assets, smart_meter_interval_csv, telemetry, outage_reports, safety_rules, knowledge_base. Arrays contain explicitly typed records; unknown fields are rejected.
shared_schema.meter_reading: CSV header timestamp,meter_id,asset_id,consumption_kwh; timezone-aware timestamps strictly increasing per meter; finite nonnegative consumption. Example has winter and summer half-hour observations with intentional gaps.
shared_schema.grid_asset: Fictitious SYN identifier, substation/device kind, boolean critical marker, validated connected_to references
shared_schema.outage_report: Unique report_id, registered asset_id, timezone-aware timestamp, hazard, declared priority
shared_schema.telemetry: SCADA-style JSON with timestamp, asset_id, voltage_kv, load_mw, status, emissions {value,unit,source}
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status (answered/abstained), answer, abstention_reason, citations, entities, protection. File/schema errors use schema_version,status=error,error and exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate() boundary checks every entity before retrieval. Answer callable outputs are validated against immutable retrieved excerpts.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated shared request -> deterministic knowledge retrieval -> cited extractive answer or explicit abstention -> recursive critical identifier redaction.

behavior.retrieval: Lowercase token matching against KB titles/tags after stopword removal; require at least 50% query-token coverage; rank by overlap descending and article ID ascending; top three.
behavior.grounding: Answers consist solely of cited KB excerpts, never inferred operational status or restoration predictions.
behavior.abstention: Empty/no sufficiently relevant knowledge yields null answer, empty citations and explicit reason; abstention exits 0.
behavior.optional_callable: Python API answer_request(data, answer_callable=None). Injected local callable receives copied, redacted question/evidence; returns answer and evidence_ids. Exact excerpt equality and citation membership required. CLI uses deterministic mode.
behavior.asset_protection: Case-insensitive recursive redaction of all registered critical identifiers before external callable input and final output; generic CLI errors never echo input or paths.
behavior.outage_safety: Fixed declared rules life_safety=critical, essential_service=high, routine=normal; inconsistent priorities and rule overrides rejected.
behavior.emissions: Structured figures must be finite and nonnegative with kgCO2e, tCO2e or gCO2e/kWh units and a nonblank source.

included: Clearly labeled synthetic grid topology and seasonal consumption
Knowledge retrieval, exact cited answers, abstention
excluded: Authentication, encryption and production access control
Semantic truth verification of operator-authored KB prose or emissions source
Outage dispatch or physical asset control

coverage: Unknown question and empty knowledge abstention
Injected callable grounding and mutation isolation
CLI success, usage, file errors, malformed JSON and duplicate keys
